purpose: How many chairs are needed when two signup lists overlap?
meaning: Add the sizes of two finite lists, then subtract their shared people once. The overlap was included in both lists, while a distinct attendee needs only one chair. Subtracting the overlap corrects double counting of attendees who appear on both lists.

definition.setting: At a community workshop, list A records woodcraft signups and list B records repair signups. Each person attending either activity needs one chair at the joint opening talk.
